skill.name: Dead Eye
skill.action: Deal real rifle damage; small precision bonus for confirmed headshots.

skill.name: Demolitions Expert
skill.action: Deal real explosive damage to hostiles; useful destruction of previously intact world obstacles, with a strict area budget.

skill.name: Spear Master
skill.action: Deal real spear damage, including power attacks.

skill.name: Quick and Perceptive
skill.action: Spear combat; small secondary share of the same confirmed hit.

skill.name: The Infiltrator
skill.action: Discover previously unrecorded live mines/traps at close range; safely clear those hazards. Never require taking trap damage.

skill.name: Animal Tracker
skill.action: First close-range discovery of a living wild animal, then successfully hunt it. Discovery route must work at rank zero without tracking markers.

skill.name: The Penetrator
skill.action: Confirmed rifle headshots and damage to armoured hostiles; verified penetration may earn a bounded bonus.

skill.name: Treasure Hunter
skill.action: Complete buried-supply/treasure digs and first-open buried treasure; useful excavation inside the active objective area.

skill.name: Salvage Operations
skill.action: Recover real materials with salvage tools from world objects; no rewards for damage without recovered resources.

skill.name: Perception Mastery
skill.action: Small advanced-practice share from Perception activities once the native mastery entry requirement is met.

skill.name: Boomstick
skill.action: Deal real shotgun damage to hostiles.

skill.name: Pummel Pete
skill.action: Deal real club/bat damage to hostiles.

skill.name: Skull Crusher
skill.action: Deal real sledgehammer damage to hostiles.

skill.name: Grand Slam
skill.action: Club/bat/sledge power hits and actual knockdowns; no extra credit for striking an already defeated target.

skill.name: Big and Fast
skill.action: Club/bat/sledge combat; small secondary share of confirmed hits.

skill.name: Pack Mule
skill.action: Travel on foot with genuine encumbrance, credited by distance and load. Standing still, teleporting or riding gives none.

skill.name: Strength Mastery
skill.action: Small advanced-practice share from Strength activities once the native mastery entry requirement is met.

skill.name: Miner 69'er
skill.action: Extract real wood, stone and ore with the appropriate mining/harvesting tools.

skill.name: Mother Lode
skill.action: Recover real natural resources while mining; normalize bulk yields so large stacks cannot bypass the curve.

skill.name: Junk Miner
skill.action: Recover resources from non-natural world blocks and scrap piles with appropriate tools; exclude player-placed break/rebuild loops.

skill.name: The Brawler
skill.action: Deal real fist/knuckle damage to hostiles.

skill.name: Machine Gunner
skill.action: Deal real machine-gun damage to hostiles.

skill.name: Lightning Hands
skill.action: Fist/knuckle combat; small secondary share of confirmed hits.

skill.name: The Huntsman
skill.action: Harvest genuine animal corpses for meat, hide and bone; each corpse has a total practice budget.

skill.name: Pain Tolerance
skill.action: Survive a genuine hostile encounter with incoming enemy damage; bounded encounter award, no self/fire/fall/friendly damage.

skill.name: Fortitude Mastery
skill.action: Small advanced-practice share from Fortitude activities once the native mastery entry requirement is met.

skill.name: Siphoning Strikes
skill.action: Successful melee combat while actually wounded; bounded recovery/combat share without requiring the perk effect at rank zero.

skill.name: Healing Factor
skill.action: Recover health actually lost to recent hostile damage; budget by original injury and exclude self-inflicted healing loops.

skill.name: Iron Gut
skill.action: Restore genuine hunger/thirst with food and drink during active play. Nutrition variety can help; consuming at full needs gives none.

skill.name: Rule 1: Cardio
skill.action: Sustained on-foot sprinting credited by valid distance and stamina effort; no running against a wall.

skill.name: Archery
skill.action: Deal real bow/crossbow damage to hostiles.

skill.name: Gunslinger
skill.action: Deal real pistol/revolver/SMG damage according to native weapon perk tags.

skill.name: Deep Cuts
skill.action: Deal real knife/blade damage; skinning offers a smaller useful-action route. Bleed damage is attributed once to its originating attack.

skill.name: Whirlwind
skill.action: Knife/blade combat; small secondary share of confirmed hits.

skill.name: Run and Gun
skill.action: Move on foot while reloading a weapon used in a recent hostile encounter; no empty-magazine idle reload farming.

skill.name: Hard Target
skill.action: Move/sprint while actively pursued or attacked by a hostile, using distance and encounter budgets rather than requiring damage taken.

skill.name: Parkour
skill.action: Meaningful jumps/vaults with displacement or height gain during travel; repeated jumps in the same spot diminish to zero.

skill.name: Agility Mastery
skill.action: Small advanced-practice share from Agility activities once the native mastery entry requirement is met.

skill.name: Hidden Strike
skill.action: Deal confirmed sneak-attack damage to unaware hostiles.

skill.name: From The Shadows
skill.action: Travel undetected near actual unaware hostiles; first infiltration/escape per encounter. Empty-room crouching gives none.

skill.name: Electrocutioner
skill.action: Deal real baton/stun-baton damage to hostiles.

skill.name: Robotics Inventor
skill.action: Player-owned deployed turret/robotic-sledge damage to hostiles, plus actual robotics assembly/repair; retain ownership attribution.

skill.name: Calculated Attack
skill.action: Baton combat; small secondary share of confirmed hits.

skill.name: Better Barter
skill.action: Complete genuine item trades with traders, with daily economic budgets and reverse-transaction suppression; no buy/sell-back loop.

skill.name: The Daring Adventurer
skill.action: Complete unique trader quests and higher difficulty objectives; credit once per quest instance.

skill.name: Charismatic Nature
skill.action: Finish cooperative objectives/support allies; solo alternative through successful trader quest hand-ins. No party required to start.

skill.name: Physician
skill.action: Restore real missing health or treat a genuine injury with medical items; credit each injury/recovery only once.

skill.name: Advanced Engineering
skill.action: Complete useful station/electrical/construction production, repair machinery or install a newly working circuit; no placement/pickup loops.

skill.name: Grease Monkey
skill.action: Assemble vehicle components/vehicles, repair real vehicle damage, and maintain them; ordinary driving offers a small capped route.

skill.name: Intellect Mastery
skill.action: Small advanced-practice share from Intellect activities once the native mastery entry requirement is met.

skill.name: Light Armor
skill.action: Move and fight in light armour during genuine hostile encounters; credit activity, not standing in armour.

skill.name: Medium Armor
skill.action: Move and fight in medium armour during genuine hostile encounters; mixed sets split a single armour-practice budget.

skill.name: Heavy Armor
skill.action: Move and fight in heavy armour during genuine hostile encounters; no reward for deliberately taking self damage.

skill.name: Master Chef
skill.action: Complete actual food/drink preparation, scaled to recipe work and cost; exclude wrapping/unwrapping the same food.

skill.name: Living off the Land
skill.action: Harvest mature planted crops and produce seeds/compost; no credit for planting and immediately removing the same seed.

skill.name: Lock Picking
skill.action: Successfully open a previously locked world container with lockpicks; never credit relocking owned storage.

skill.name: Lucky Looter
skill.action: First search of genuine world loot, with lower budget for trash and no reopening player containers.
